from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess, datetime
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/'_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/evidence/story-6-4/qualification-20261017-parent'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def identity(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with p.open('rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(b)
 return {'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':h.hexdigest()}
base=root/'_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/evidence'
p1r=sorted({f for d in base.glob('6-1-p1r*') if d.is_dir() for f in d.rglob('*') if f.is_file() and not f.is_symlink()})
historical=sorted(f for f in (base/'story-6-4').iterdir() if f.is_file() and not f.name.startswith('qualification-20261017-'))
protected=[root/p for p in ['.editorconfig','.gitattributes','.gitleaks.toml','Directory.Build.props','Directory.Build.targets','Directory.Packages.props','global.json','_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-projection-cost-sequence-guard.md','_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml']]
protected+=sorted((root/'tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Server.Tests/Security').glob('SecretsProtectionTests*'))
payload={'capturedUtc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'scope':'Read-only capture after user expanded qualification authorization; before parent decision packet. Raw content is never copied into the packet.','p1r':[identity(p) for p in p1r],'historicalStory64':[identity(p) for p in historical],'protected':[identity(p) for p in protected]}
blob=(json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n').encode()
(out/'preservation-before.json').write_bytes(blob)
print(json.dumps({'path':str(out/'preservation-before.json'),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),'p1rFiles':len(p1r),'p1rBytes':sum(x['bytes'] for x in payload['p1r']),'historicalStory64Files':len(historical),'protectedFiles':len(protected)},indent=2))
